name: Fischerstadl
kurzbeschreibung: Rustic fish restaurant on the Erlensee in Brixen im Thale with a lakeside terrace, home-smoked fish from its own waters and a view of the Hohe Salve.
beschreibung: The Restaurant Fischerstadl is located directly on the Erlensee in the Brixental in Brixen im Thale. The rustic wooden house offers a sun terrace with a view of the Hohe Salve and a cosy parlour with a tiled stove. Freshly caught fish from its own waters – also home-smoked – as well as dishes from upscale cuisine are served. The fish come directly from the Erlensee or other local waters and are prepared with ingredients from local producers. In addition to fish dishes, the menu also includes meat dishes, vegetarian options, salads and sweet dishes. In the afternoon there is coffee and homemade cakes. For the little guests there is a playground. The restaurant is also suitable for private celebrations and larger groups. Fishing is possible from 9 a.m. to 6 p.m. Monday is a rest day, the hot food is served from 12 to 9 p.m.
